title: Signing Gap and the Door Bundle Rate
content:
# Signing Gap and the Door Bundle Rate

Window Replacement Contracts. The bundle rate is multiplied by a timing share set by the calendar days between the signing date of the window contract and that of the paired door contract: more than 30 days (the late add-on day count) takes the late add-on share of 0.7; more than 14 days (the prompt day count) but no more than 30 takes the mid add-on share of 0.9; no more than 14 days takes a share of one.

The gap is counted the same way whichever contract was signed first. The share multiplies the bundle rate in full, that is the window series bundle percentage together with every amount added to it, before the rate is applied to the amount the credit is figured on; the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Calendar days between the two signing dates | Timing share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | 1 |
| 15 to 30 | 0.9 |
| 31 or more | 0.7 |

## Boundaries (hypothetical window contract signed 2036-03-01)

- Door signed 2036-03-15 (14 days): 1; 2036-03-16 (15 days): 0.9.
- Door signed 2036-03-31 (30 days): 0.9; 2036-04-01 (31 days): 0.7.
- Door signed 2036-02-14 (16 days earlier): 0.9.
